summary: Completed frontend-only regression and responsive matrix retest. Verified old pipeline crash path with incomplete lead `lead-email-test` is fixed (pipeline renders, tab navigation stable across 320/768/1024/1440 in EN/SK, refine modal opens). Found pageerrors tied to clipboard copy actions in pipeline export tools.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking `copy-crm-btn` and `copy-md-btn` triggers unhandled pageerrors: `Failed to execute 'writeText' on 'Clipboard': Write permission denied.`

action_items: Wrap `navigator.clipboard.writeText(...)` in PipelineView copy handlers with try/catch and show non-crashing UI notice when clipboard permission is denied.
Keep strict pageerror cleanliness for export actions so responsive sweeps remain green with copy buttons exercised.
critical_code_review_comments: `PipelineView.copyForCRM` and `PipelineView.copyAllMarkdown` do not handle clipboard rejection; this causes unhandled runtime pageerrors in restricted clipboard contexts.
Regression fix for partial lead normalization is effective: incomplete saved lead no longer crashes ProspectCard render path.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin and existing saved lead `lead-email-test`. No delete/modify actions performed on that record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Completed full matrix on 320/768/1024/1440 and EN/SK for discover/audit/pipeline/guide with proper mobile-vs-desktop navigation selectors; no horizontal overflow and no header/content overlap detected. Provider modal close text localized (EN: Close, SK: Zatvoriť). Refine modal on incomplete record opens in both languages after repeated tab switches. Only failing signal is clipboard pageerrors from pipeline copy buttons.
rca of the issue: RCA: responsive timeout suspicion from prior iteration is resolved by the normalizeProspect crash fix and stable tab selector branching per breakpoint. Current failing signal is unrelated to layout: pipeline copy actions call clipboard API without rejection handling. In automation/restricted permission environments, `navigator.clipboard.writeText` rejects and surfaces pageerrors. Mitigation: catch clipboard exceptions, set user-visible fallback notice, and avoid unhandled promise rejection.
